title: Strawberry 100%
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Middle-schooler Junpei Manaka glimpses a girl's strawberry-print underwear on the school roof and sets out to find her, assuming she is the popular Tsukasa Nishino when she is really the bookish Aya Tojo. In high school he is torn between Aya, Tsukasa and the forward Satsuki Kitaoji while chasing his dream of directing films, with Aya as his writer (VIZ blurb via AniList; Comic Book Bin review of volume 4).
life_message: Growing up means pursuing your dreams and eventually being honest about whom you love.
